children: Shares of Viking Therapeutics shares fell after the company said it has priced concurrent public offerings of 7.9 million shares at $35 a share, and $225 million of 2.00% convertible senior notes due 2032.
The stock was 12% lower, at $36.58, in premarket trade.
The offering sizes of the common stock offering and the note offering were increased from the previously announced offering size of $200 million of shares and $200 million of notes.
The issuance and sale of the stock and the notes are scheduled to settle Friday.

Viking said it has granted the underwriters of the stock offering a 30-day option to buy up to an additional 1.2 million shares, and granted the underwriters of the note offering a 30-day option to buy up to an additional $33.75 million of notes solely to cover over-allotments.

The completion of the common stock offering will not be contingent on the completion of the note offering, and the note offering's completion will not be contingent on the completion of the common stock offering.

Viking said it intends to use the proceeds from the note offering, together with the net proceeds from the stock offering, for the continued clinical development, advancement and commercialization of its VK2735 program, the continued clinical development and advancement of its VK3019 program and for other general research and development, working capital and general corporate purposes.
